# Cecil & Lou

> Cecil & Lou is a family-owned children's clothing boutique in Tyler, Texas, founded in 2011. It sells classic Southern clothing for babies, toddlers, and kids (newborn to size 12): hand-smocked, appliqué, embroidered, and monogrammed dresses, bubbles, jon jons, rompers, sets, pajamas, swim, and accessories, plus matching sibling, mommy-and-me, and family pajama styles.

Online store: https://www.cecilandlou.com. It ships to the US and 27 other countries via USPS. All sales are final, and monogrammed and personalized items are made to order. Many styles are sold as pre-orders with a shipping window listed on each product page. In-stock items leave the warehouse within 3 business days.

Last updated: 2026-09-30. Contact: help@cecilandlou.com, 903-308-3235 (Mon–Fri, 8am–5pm Central).

## Shop by category

- [Girls](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/girls): Dresses, bubbles, sets, pajamas, and accessories, newborn to size 12
- [Boys](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/boys): Jon jons, rompers, bubbles, sets, tops, and swim
- [Baby](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/baby): Newborn and infant clothing
- [Layette](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/layette): Newborn essentials and coming-home outfits
- [Pajamas](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/pajamas): Kids sleepwear, including matching family pajamas
- [Accessories](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/accessories): Bows, hats, socks, tights, backpacks, luggage, and towels
- [Womens](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/womens): Women's clothing and pajamas

## Shop by style

- [Smocked](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/smocked): Hand-smocked children's clothing, year-round
- [Monogrammed Clothing](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/monogrammed-clothing): Personalized, made-to-order pieces
- [Custom Smocked](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/custom): Made-to-order smocked outfits, which can be personalized
- [Heirloom](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/collections-heirloom): Heirloom-quality outfits for special occasions and photos
- [Matching Sibling Outfits](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/matching-sibling-outfits): Coordinated looks for brothers and sisters
- [Mommy and Me](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/mommy-and-me): Matching mother and child styles
